data.question: Is there a documented path connecting Brett Leatherman to WEF?
data.method: Exact event reconciliation using official FBI and WEF sources.
findings: Leatherman represented the FBI at the February 20, 2024 Operation Cronos announcement.
WEF published dedicated coverage on February 21, 2024 and later surfaced it through Cybercrime Atlas.
The path Brett Leatherman -> Operation Cronos -> World Economic Forum is established.
Direct personal WEF affiliation remains not established.
conclusions: Add this graph path to dataset wef.
Classify it as an indirect operational/content tie.
Do not label Leatherman a WEF member, employee, adviser, contributor or event participant.
counterarguments: WEF reporting is weaker than participation in a WEF program.
limitations: The path proves a shared event object, not personal affiliation.
